key.name: hide-when-idle
key.summary: Hide the notch while no agent session is running

key.name: overlay-panel
key.summary: Cover the top bar instead of hanging below it

key.name: auto-open-requests
key.summary: Open the notch by itself when an agent asks for permission

key.name: monitor
key.summary: Connector of the monitor the notch lives on (empty: the primary monitor)

key.name: snap-threshold
key.summary: Pixels from a screen edge where the notch docks to it

key.name: position-x
key.summary: Horizontal centre of a notch the user moved, in screen pixels (-1: top centre)

key.name: position-y
key.summary: Top edge of a notch the user moved, in screen pixels (-1: just under the panel)

key.name: decision-timeout
key.summary: Seconds a permission card stays before it closes (the terminal keeps asking)

key.name: finished-linger
key.summary: Seconds a finished session stays visible
